Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production
Taufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder.

THE WHAT

- Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
- Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
- Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE

- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
- Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

We need an engineer who will own this research, drive it forward independently, and help us produce tanks that do not fail.

The Why: You are the owner of our composite winding process research. You don’t inherit a finished method – you develop one. From experiment design to test execution, data analysis to team knowledge transfer: you plan the work, run it, and take responsibility for the results.

- Experiments are designed thoroughly and executed to plan.
- Findings are analyzed critically and translated into concrete process improvements.
- Knowledge is documented andsharedso the team moves forward together.

YOUR MISSION

Research and improve the composite winding process: Design and run experiments to advance our winding process and improve tank performance. Learn from every project, increase your efficiency over time, and develop improvement ideas.

High Performance – Deliver strong results under pressure. Each project makes the next one better.

Accountability – Own your work. Follow through. Deliver results independently.

Candor – Surface problems early. Speak up. Fix things faster.

- Systems & Equipment Oversight: Manage the end-to-end supply chain for complex systems and equipment integrated into combat and UAV platforms. Ensure all components meet stringent defense-grade specifications.
- Performance Recovery & Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical and supply risks within the systems ecosystem. Implement preventative surveillance plans and robust recovery actions to ensure zero disruption to combat-ready platforms.
- Stakeholder Leadership: Act as the key technical interface between Engineering, Procurement, and external Tier-1 system suppliers. Contribute to Sub-Commodity strategies through active participation in Multi-Functional Teams (MFT).
- Technical Quality Assurance: Secure industrial maturity by conducting specialized supplier audits and assessments (e.g., APQP, IPCA, CCPs, Transfers of Work). You will manage corrective action plans to eliminate deviations and concessions.
- Global Oversight: While based in Manching, you will conduct on-site supplier audits and technical assessments at various locations worldwide to ensure compliance with defense standards and operational excellence.
- Governance: Contribute to Vendor Review Board (VRB) meetings and represent SCQ Operations in high-level forums.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Systems & Equipment Expertise: Advanced technical knowledge or proven expertise in Systems and Equipment (Avionics, Mission Systems, Sensors, or specialized UAV hardware) within the context of combat or unmanned aerial platforms.
- Education & Experience: Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field and professional experience in a highly regulated industry (Aerospace preferred).
- Audit & Quality Mastery: Demonstrated experience in auditing (preferably as Airbus Supplier Lead Auditor), assessing supplier capability, and managing industrial maturity (APQP/PPAP frameworks).
- Language Proficiency: Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. You must be able to negotiate and lead technical discussions in both languages.
- Defense Mindset: A deep understanding of the unique quality, security, and reliability requirements of combat and unmanned systems.
- Change Management: Proven ability to work autonomously in complex Supply Chain Change Management environments involving highly sensitive technology.
- Tools: Proficiency in Procurement IT tools and ERP systems.
- Analytical Leadership: Ability to monitor complex performance metrics and lead data-driven recovery actions for sophisticated technical components.
- Mobility: Willingness and ability to travel internationally for supplier audits and site visits.

jobs.description:
Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Industrialization Supply Chain & Quality Manager (d/f/m)

In this role you will join the Supply Chain and Quality department in the Composite and Metallic Detail Parts team as part of the Procurement Organization. 70% of the Aircraft value is manufactured by Supply Chain, as a Procurement professional you will have the chance of working with the very exciting products of Airbus and at the same time being the main interface with multinational companies of different technologies.

In your daily operations you will be contributing to the future of the Air Power Programmes: Supplier Selection, Supplier Certification, New Product Industrialization, Supplier Performance and Surveillance.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- You lead the End-to-End Supply Chain Operations and Quality Management and act as Supply Chain Industrial, Operations and Quality leader for all the suppliers under the applicable scope
- You represent Airbus Defence and Space in front of Suppliers and Ensure the Industrial Maturity and Quality / Operational performance of Suppliers.
- You represent procurement organization in the associated Multi-Functional Team and in front of Authorities during Audits and Assessments
- You lead the deployment of Airbus DS Quality and Supply Chain requirements in suppliers and for the main ADS programs
- You are in charge and/or participate in: - Calls for Tender process from the Operational and Quality points of view
- New Products Introduction, Transfer of Work, Industrial Changes, Modifications, Assessments
- APQP deployment in suppliers
- Risk & Opportunities Management
- Management of Quality Escapes and all type of non-conformities, leading all the associated activities with internal and external stakeholders
- Leading the root case analysis and associated actions plans from both a corrective and preventative point of view
- Qualifications and Certifications surveillance
- First Article Inspection
- Supplier Performance & Surveillance
- Deployment of Procurement Tools in the supplier

Desired skills and qualifications

- Educated to degree level (or equivalent) in engineering or a related discipline
- Experience in Supply Chain Quality or/and in Supply Chain
- Rigorous, autonomous, customer-oriented mind-set and ability to prioritise workload
- Excellent interpersonal skills, including communication, multi-functional team-working, flexibility, proactive behavior
- Negotiation level communication skills in English and Spanish are required
